dg-len.label: Deliveries with a length tag
dg-len.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-len.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN c.length IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) len, SUM(CASE WHEN c.speed_kph IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) spd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.required_rr <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rrr FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id

dg-spd.label: Deliveries with a speed
dg-spd.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-spd.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN c.length IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) len, SUM(CASE WHEN c.speed_kph IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) spd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.required_rr <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rrr FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id

dg-rrr.label: Deliveries with a non-zero stored required run rate
dg-rrr.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-rrr.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN c.length IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) len, SUM(CASE WHEN c.speed_kph IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) spd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.required_rr <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rrr FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id

dg-potm.label: Matches with a player of the match recorded
dg-potm.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-potm.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN player_of_match_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) potm, SUM(CASE WHEN margin_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) margin FROM matches

dg-cty.label: Players with a known nationality in the players table
dg-cty.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-cty.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN country IS NOT NULL AND country <> 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cty, SUM(CASE WHEN batting_style IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bat FROM players

dg-bd.label: Gujarat Titans' balls since 2024 faced by batters with a known birth date
dg-bd.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dg-bd.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name

dg-part.label: Rows in the partnerships table
dg-part.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
